scope: Linux isolated workspaces, bounded Python input/output properties
deadline_scope: work admitted and each execution/HTTP call bounded by remaining deadline; supervisor cleanup and receipt persistence reported separately within elapsed time
review: S may self-review; F/E at most 2 critic calls and at most one per snapshot identity
library: empty and frozen in principal comparison
runtime_reproducibility: host /usr read-only, nonhermetic; persistent execution-result cache disabled
cpu_accounting: child cgroup quota; host process CPU reported separately; no electrical-energy claim
http_provider: explicit same-origin tokenization preflight and completion API; no request without total token reservation; remote identity is operator-declared
oracle: pcworld-reference-1, supervisor only, finite relation checks
scientific_sample: not frozen; select independent tasks and power from a real pilot
development_fixtures: 4 public properties; cannot stand in for 60 independent benchmark tasks
